title: Expelled from school and leaving for a road show
summary: Roy was expelled after being caught with a white girl and left home on the day his father was to return him to school.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: This is when I left to school. Got a job to go to Sharon, Pennsylvania, with this road show, you know. In the meantime, I got kicked out of school. I told you that...

Well, there was this little girl, ha... It was a White girl, you know. And right from babies we'd been tight, you know. We'd never really got into it, but we started getting close, you know. And it was getting to that stage where it was about to jump off. Man, we got caught in the cloakroom in the wrong position, you know. So they expelled both of us. But we were supposed to go back. And the date my father was supposed to come from work and take me back, that's the morning I left home. ]
